title: 12 Best Fine Dining in Copenhagen
description: Discover Copenhagen's top 12 fine dining restaurants for 2026. From Michelin-starred marvels like Geranium to unique culinary journeys, find your perfect gourmet experience. Explore prices, menus, and insider tips.

places.name: Geranium
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Universe' tasting menu, a meticulously curated sequence of dishes reflecting the season and the chef's philosophy.

places.name: Alchemist
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order There's only one option: the full 'Holistic' journey, a fixed menu that unfolds over several hours.

places.name: Jordnær
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The tasting menu, especially with the optional caviar enhancements, which are a highlight of their seafood-centric approach.

places.name: Kadeau Copenhagen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The extensive tasting menu, which is a poetic interpretation of Bornholm's landscapes and culinary traditions.

places.name: AOC
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The full tasting menu with the recommended wine pairing to fully appreciate the interplay of flavors and textures.

places.name: Kong Hans Kælder
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature truffled chicken or lobster dishes, often featured on the tasting menu, are legendary and a must-try for first-time visitors.

places.name: Marchal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Grand Menu' is an excellent choice, or for a slightly less formal experience, their acclaimed brunch is a taste of luxury. Don't miss their exquisite caviar selection.

places.name: Formel B
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Embrace their flexible concept by selecting several of their small plates to create your own personalized tasting menu.

places.name: STUDIO
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seasonal tasting menu, particularly any dishes highlighting local Danish seafood, which is a specialty here.

places.name: Mielcke & Hurtigkarl
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The tasting menu, which changes frequently to reflect the bounty of the garden and the chef's creative whims.

places.name: ARK
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The full plant-based tasting menu; even non-vegans rave about the creativity and depth of flavor.

places.name: Høst
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Høst Menu' (tasting menu) is renowned for its incredible value and seasonal delights. Their house-baked bread and special butter are legendary.
